adjudication.rationale: The migration backfill inserts each legacy line with raw SQL `VALUES ('#{h}', ...)` (db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb), so `EmbeddableHost`’s `before_validation` normalization (stripping `https?://` and paths) is never applied. The new allow-check `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` parses the referer/embed URL to `uri.host` and then does `where("lower(host) = ?", host)`, which will not match rows stored as `http://discourse.org` or `https://example.com/1234` (and the diff shows such values were previously supported in specs). Splitting on `"\n"` also leaves potential `\r`/whitespace/blank lines that would be inserted verbatim, creating junk rows.
